transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I just haven't been doing much lately. I've sort of stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. 

Just... stopped going to church gatherings, or salsa nights. Haven't been cooking for the neighbors either. I don't even walk out to my shop anymore. I'm a carpenter, and usually I'd go in there just to enjoy the smell of the wood, but... I just don't want to. I don't know. That's mostly it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yeah... I suppose. 

It’s mostly in the mornings. I just wake up with this... heavy, empty feeling in my chest. It’s hard to explain. It just feels like the color has kind of gone out of the house. 

I try to keep it to myself, mostly. I just have to force myself not to... you know, break down in front of my wife. But yeah. I guess it's been most days.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy, like carpentry or dancing?

Yeah. Like I mentioned a minute ago... I just stopped wanting to do any of it. The dancing, church, cooking... even just going out to the shop. I just don't have the drive for the things that usually keep me going.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’ve let people down, even when there’s no real reason for it?

I... I don't know. Maybe. 

It's just... my wife's health. I keep going over it in my head. Replaying every appointment we had... every little change in her. I just keep thinking that... a better husband would have caught it sooner. That I should have protected her somehow. 

I don't really want to talk about it much, but... yeah. I guess I do feel like I let her down.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or unable to sit still?

I guess... yeah. The guys at the shop mentioned something. 

Sometimes I just... I feel like my boots are full of wet cement. It takes me forever just to pick up a board or measure a cut. Other times... I don't know. I just can't settle. I end up pacing around the shop, just rubbing my hands together. Not getting anything done. 

It's just... hard to focus, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
No, not really. I guess I eat about the same. Haven't been paying much attention to the scale or anything.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About... two months, I guess. 

Ever since my wife got sick and... everything changed. When her health went downhill, our whole routine just kind of stopped. So, yeah. Two months of this.
Have you been feeling guilty about things you did or didn't do, even if others say it wasn't your fault?

I don't know... I mean, maybe. 

It's just... I keep going over everything in my head. Every doctor's appointment, every little thing she complained about before she got real bad. I just keep thinking... if I was a better husband, I would've noticed. I should have caught it sooner. Protected her, you know? It's hard not to feel like I messed up.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy levels or felt unusually tired lately, even when you’re not doing much?

Yeah, I guess. I'm just... tired all the time. 

Even if I sleep all night, or just sit around the house, I wake up feeling like I've been framing a roof all day. My body just feels heavy. Just... worn out. Even little things, like... loading my tools into the truck. It just feels like too much work. I don't know why.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I... I've had times where I felt a bit low before, sure. But not like this. 

This time, it's... it's been going on for a while. About six months, I think. It's not just a bad week or... or normal stress from work. It's just dragging on and on. I haven't really felt right for a half a year now.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down nearly every day and lost interest in things for at least two weeks or more?
I don't think so. I mean, not that I remember. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing like this.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time when you felt down nearly every day and lost interest in things for at least two weeks or more?
No. Like I just said... I don't think so. Never two weeks straight or anything. Just... this time.
Have you ever had a period in your life, before this current time, when you felt down nearly every day and stopped caring about things for two weeks or more?

Look... you just asked me that. Twice. 

I don't know why you keep repeating it, but my answer hasn't changed. No. Never before this.
Has this low mood and loss of interest in activities lasted for a continuous period of two years or more?
Two years? ...No. Nowhere near that long. Just... lately.
Before this current time, have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down nearly every day and stopped caring about things?
Doc... you're asking me the exact same thing again. I don't... I don't have a different answer for you. No. I haven't.
Would you say that your current low mood and lack of interest in activities have been present nearly every day for at least two months?
Yeah. About two months, I guess. Ever since... well, my wife's health took a sudden bad turn around then. It kind of threw our whole routine out the window. So... yeah. Two months.
